title: Life with Inbrija for Parkinson's patients with OFF episodes - non-interventional study
summary: The aim of this study is to gain insights from routine clinical practice regarding the use of Inbrija® (inhaled levodopa) in patients with Parkinson’s disease who experience so-called “OFF” episodes. “OFF” episodes are times when the effects of Parkinson’s medications become less effective and symptoms such as movement disorders, tremor, or even non-motor symptoms may reoccur more severely. Inbrija® is used as On-demand therapy. This means that the medication can be taken in addition to regular treatment when OFF episodes occur to alleviate symptoms. Its efficacy and tolerability have already been evaluated in clinical trials. This non-interventional study observes how Inbrija® is used in everyday life—for example, in terms of tolerability, handling, effectiveness, and quality of life. The study does not influence the treatment itself.

interventions.name: Patients with Parkinson’s disease and “OFF” episodes who are being treated with levodopa and a dopa decarboxylase inhibitor may use Inbrija® as needed for the intermittent treatment of episodic motor fluctuations (“OFF” episodes), as determined by their doctor. The observation period is 3 months.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
·     Adult patients with Parkinson’s disease and OFF episodes who are receiving stable therapy with levodopa and a dopa decarboxylase inhibitor (benserazide or carbidopa),
·     Inbrija®-naive patients for whom treatment with Inbrija® is indicated and for whom the decision to initiate treatment with Inbrija®, in accordance with the prescribing information, was made independently by the treating physician prior to study enrollment, 
·     Patients who have the necessary understanding to recognize OFF symptoms and can prepare the inhaler themselves, or who have a caregiver who can prepare the inhaler for them when needed, 
•	written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
·     Patients who, according to the contraindications listed in the prescribing information, must not be treated with Inbrija®,
Patients who are currently participating in a clinical trial.
